gbm_population_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed primary glioblastoma by World Health Organization (WHO) 2021 criteria

candidate_evidence.quote: Mycophenolate mofetil blocks enzyme activity which can disrupt tumor activity and may make the tumor more sensitive to radiation and/or temozolomide.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed primary glioblastoma by World Health Organization (WHO) 2021 criteria

role_evidence.quote:
PRIMARY OBJECTIVE:

I. To compare the overall survival (OS) (phase III) and progression-free survival (PFS) (phase II) between the experimental arm (mycophenolate mofetil \[MMF\] + standard of care \[SOC\]) and the control arm (SOC).

agents.drug_class_hint: immunosuppressant, IMPDH inhibitor (mycophenolate mofetil is the morpholinoethyl ester prodrug of mycophenolic acid)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: blocks enzyme activity which can disrupt tumor activity and may make the tumor more sensitive to radiation and/or temozolomide

role_evidence.quote: This phase II/III trial tests how well adding mycophenolate mofetil, to the usual treatment with intensity-modulated radiation therapy and temozolomide works for the treatment of glioblastoma

coder_notes: Both arms are registered as EXPERIMENTAL, but Arm I (radiotherapy + temozolomide) works as the control, so control_arm_from_other_arms is yes. mycophenolate mofetil is mapped to the parent moiety mycophenolic acid per the ester-to-parent rule.
